label: Standardized 100 MWac / 120 MWp utility-scale solar reconciliation case
purpose: Provide one fixed input set that can be run independently in Core v3 and an external bank/project-finance model.
conventions_to_reconcile: P50 and P90 are energy cases using the same tariff/opex assumptions
debt service is level annual debt service
DSRA is sized as months of annual debt service and funded by equity at financial close
DSRA is released to equity at debt maturity
LLCR is NPV of CFADS during remaining loan life discounted at debt rate divided by outstanding debt at financial close
tax is intentionally zero in this standard case
construction drawdown, IDC, depreciation, working capital and sculpted debt are intentionally excluded
warning: The baseline outputs are Core v3 outputs for reconciliation; they are not bank-approved answers. External model differences must be explained before Gate V3-GATE-02 can pass.
